tools.name: nightdrive_status
tools.title: Nightdrive status
tools.description: What this desktop is and runs: Nightdrive's version and update channel, Fedora's version, the theme and wallpaper, the region (how the user writes dates and times: write them so), the displays (resolution, scale), and which of Nightdrive's apps and plugins are installed, turned off or available. Use it before answering about this machine's setup.

tools.name: hub_status
tools.title: Hub sync status
tools.description: Nightdrive Hub, which syncs Tasks between the user's computers: the Hub's address, when the last sync went through and the last try's state (ok, offline: the changes wait, error), and per app what the last sync did (fetched, sent, merged: a task edited on two computers, the older edit's values put in its notes; kept_both) and what waits to be sent from this computer. joined is false when this computer syncs with no Hub.
